moments.title: European Athletics Championships begin
moments.blurb: The European Athletics Championships kick off in Birmingham, bringing top athletes from across the continent to the UK for a week of track and field action.

angles.name: Main Event
angles.copy: It's a huge week for sport as the European Athletics Championships get underway in Birmingham! Who are you backing for gold?

angles.name: Birmingham Buzz
angles.copy: Birmingham is buzzing! The European Athletics Championships are here, bringing incredible talent and a fantastic atmosphere. Catch all the action!

moments.title: Community Shield Final
moments.blurb: The traditional curtain-raiser for the English football season, the Community Shield, sees Premier League champions Arsenal take on FA Cup holders Manchester City at Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Match Day Hype
angles.copy: The first silverware of the season is up for grabs! Arsenal vs Manchester City in the Community Shield this Sunday. Who's lifting the trophy?

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts
angles.copy: Cardiff is hosting a massive football clash this Sunday! Manchester City take on Arsenal in the Community Shield at Principality Stadium. Get ready, Wales!

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his record-breaking After Hours Til Dawn Tour to Wembley Stadium for a series of five highly anticipated shows in London.

angles.name: Wembley Weekend
angles.copy: The Weeknd is taking over Wembley Stadium this week! If you're heading to the After Hours Til Dawn tour, get ready for an epic show.

angles.name: London Calling
angles.copy: London, get ready! The Weeknd's bringing the After Hours Til Dawn tour to Wembley Stadium for multiple nights. Who's got tickets?

moments.title: Ariana Grande's O2 Residency
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande kicks off her exclusive 10-night UK residency at London's O2 Arena as part of her Eternal Sunshine Tour, her first live performances in six years.

angles.name: Ariana Arrives
angles.copy: She's back! Ariana Grande begins her massive 10-night residency at The O2 this week. Who's excited for 'Eternal Sunshine' live?

angles.name: London's Pop Queen
angles.copy: London is about to get a whole lot brighter! Ariana Grande's 'Eternal Sunshine' tour opens this week at The O2. This is HUGE!

moments.title: UK basks in summer heatwave
moments.blurb: A heatwave is gripping parts of the UK, with London expecting highs of 32°C today and temperatures potentially reaching the mid-30s across England and Wales by mid-week.

angles.name: Stay Cool
angles.copy: It's heating up out there! Stay hydrated and safe as a summer heatwave sweeps across the UK this week. Enjoy the sunshine responsibly!

angles.name: Sunny London
angles.copy: Sunshine and 32°C in London today! Make the most of this beautiful weather, but remember to keep cool.

angles.name: Wales Warmth
angles.copy: Warm weather is on the way for Wales this week, with temperatures set to climb. Perfect for enjoying the outdoors!

moments.title: Bloodstock Open Air Festival
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest independent metal festival, Bloodstock Open Air, is underway at Catton Park in Derbyshire, featuring a lineup of heavy metal acts.

angles.name: Metal Mayhem
angles.copy: Bloodstock Open Air is roaring into action this weekend! If you're at Catton Park, crank it up and enjoy the UK's biggest metal festival!

angles.name: Rock Out
angles.copy: For all the metalheads out there, Bloodstock is delivering the goods this weekend! Who's your must-see act on the lineup?

moments.title: Family Festivals this weekend
moments.blurb: Several family-friendly festivals are taking place this weekend, including LakeFest in Herefordshire (The Charlatans, Example, Madness), Deva Fest in Cheshire (Ronan Keating, Jessie J), and Gloworm Festival in Nottinghamshire.

angles.name: Festival Fun
angles.copy: Looking for family fun? LakeFest, Deva Fest, and Gloworm Festival are all happening this weekend, bringing music, arts, and entertainment to the UK!

angles.name: Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: From The Charlatans to Jessie J, there's a festival for everyone this weekend! Which one are you heading to?

moments.title: Happy 67th, Kurtis Blow!
moments.blurb: Pioneering American rapper Kurtis Blow, known for hits like 'The Breaks', celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Legend
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to the legendary Kurtis Blow! Still breaking beats and setting trends.

moments.title: Happy 54th, Juanes!
moments.blurb: Colombian rock superstar Juanes, famous for his Latin Grammy-winning music, turns 54 today.

angles.name: Rock Star Birthday
angles.copy: Feliz Cumpleaños to the incredible Juanes, who turns 54 today! What's your favourite track from the Latin rock icon?

moments.title: Happy 79th, Ian Anderson!
moments.blurb: Ian Anderson, the iconic singer, songwriter, and flautist for the progressive rock band Jethro Tull, celebrates his 79th birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Prog Rock Icon
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we're wishing a very Happy 79th Birthday to the legendary Ian Anderson of Jethro Tull! What's your go-to Tull track?

moments.title: Happy 77th, Mark Knopfler!
moments.blurb: Mark Knopfler, the distinctive guitarist and frontman of Dire Straits, celebrates his 77th birthday on Wednesday.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Get ready to wish a Happy 77th Birthday to the incredible Mark Knopfler this Wednesday! Dire Straits classics all day.

moments.title: Happy 37th, Joe Jonas!
moments.blurb: Pop sensation Joe Jonas, best known as a member of the Jonas Brothers and DNCE, celebrates his 37th birthday on Sunday.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Sunday is Joe Jonas's 37th birthday! Get ready to celebrate with some Jonas Brothers and DNCE hits.

moments.title: Ultimate Coldplay in Exeter
moments.blurb: Tribute band Ultimate Coldplay performs tonight at Exeter Phoenix, bringing the stadium experience to Devon.

angles.name: Exeter Gig
angles.copy: Get ready to sing your heart out, Exeter! Ultimate Coldplay are bringing their incredible tribute show to Exeter Phoenix tonight. Don't miss it!

moments.title: Ultimate Coldplay in Wrexham
moments.blurb: Tribute band Ultimate Coldplay will be performing at the Sausage and Cider Festival in Wrexham this Sunday.

angles.name: Wrexham Weekend
angles.copy: Wrexham, get ready for a 'Sky Full of Stars'! Ultimate Coldplay are at the Sausage and Cider Festival this Sunday. Who's going?

moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins on Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal taking on newly promoted Coventry City in the opening fixture.

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: It's almost time! The Premier League season kicks off next Friday. Who's ready for the return of top-flight football?

angles.name: Opening Weekend
angles.copy: The fixtures are out and the countdown is on! Arsenal v Coventry City is the curtain-raiser for the new Premier League season.

moments.title: EFL Season Begins
moments.blurb: The English Football League season, encompassing the Championship, League One, and League Two, officially starts next weekend.

angles.name: Lower League Football
angles.copy: Football is back across the country! The EFL season begins next weekend. Which team are you following in the Championship, League One, or League Two?

angles.name: Welsh Teams
angles.copy: Get ready, Wales! The EFL season kicks off next weekend, with Cardiff City and Swansea City among those in action. Who's your team?
